customManagers.description: Bump the yoziru/tesla-ble git dependency pinned in idf_component.yml. Upgrades across the 5.x line require manual review and patch rebase per #304; closed PR #303 was superseded by #305 and remote branch deleted so future tags (> v5.2.0) are proposed as fresh PRs.
Bump the tag and immutable digest of the shared ESP-IDF build image
Bump the esptool-js version pinned in the browser installer

packageRules.description: Never auto-merge a tracked firmware dependency, even when CI is green. A green `build` job only proves the firmware compiles — it does NOT prove the Tesla BLE crypto/pairing/signed-command path still works (yoziru/tesla-ble), nor that WiFi/BLE coexistence and runtime behaviour survive an ESP-IDF bump, nor that the browser installer still flashes (esptool-js, which the build doesn't exercise on hardware). These are only validated by a human running the live e2e against a real paired car. Renovate still opens, rebases and rebuilds the PR; a human reviews, runs e2e, and merges manually. (GitHub Action digest bumps are unaffected and keep auto-merging.)
Keep ESP-IDF on 6.x, and remind maintainers that an IDF bump also moves the Mbed TLS / TF-PSA-Crypto the PSA patch and host harness are pinned against.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Before merging — re-verify the tesla-ble PSA port.** An ESP-IDF bump changes the Mbed TLS / TF-PSA-Crypto the firmware links, and the firmware build fails closed until `MBEDTLS_REF` in scripts/test-tesla-ble-harness.sh and `MBEDTLS_COMMIT` in scripts/check-dependency-contract.py name the new image's components/mbedtls/mbedtls commit. Update both, rerun the V1 protocol vectors, and re-check patches/tesla-ble/0006-port-crypto-bindings-to-psa.patch (docs/adr/0002-idf6-mbedtls4-crypto-seam.md). Do not widen `allowedVersions` to 7.x as a routine bump.

packageRules.description: Only renovatebot/github-action in renovate.yaml is managed by Renovate; build and release workflow actions are pinned security boundaries audited in scripts/check-workflow-policy.py.
